## Error text and minimal attachments
Redact usernames, personal paths and credentials. Keep assets alongside a
shareable project. Do not upload a private project or proprietary artwork.
For visual problems, include dimensions, background, clip/time and a screenshot
you may publish. Check compatibility limitations first.
